title: Cover malformed same-request replies in the ACP direct-prompt fixture
outcome: Exercise the ACP fixture response-envelope guards with an exact pending request and a Begun write.
acceptance: Isolated incorrect JSON-RPC version, method member, both result and error, non-object result, and non-object error each return the bounded conflict for the same request ID.
Each refusal leaves the live receipt unchanged and the exact matching successful reply still settles.
